operations.name: create_location
operations.purpose: Create a location within an organization

operations.name: add_membership
operations.purpose: Join a user to an organization

operations.name: assign_role
operations.purpose: Assign a role to a membership

operations.name: grant_location_access
operations.purpose: Grant membership access to a location

operations.name: list_organizations
operations.purpose: List organizations visible through a user's active memberships

operations.name: list_locations
operations.purpose: List locations allowed by tenant context

operations.name: authorize
operations.purpose: Evaluate a permission in tenant context

invariants: Every response includes contract_version equal to 0.1.0.
Responses contain JSON primitives, arrays, and objects only.
Authorization denies inactive memberships and cross-organization or unauthorized location access.
Authorization checks emit an audit event.
The contract contains no Dental-specific entity or rule.
